content.text: Is there any reason not to make the default a queue? If not, I would suggest we do it.

The only reason I was waiting on that was because I though that would be a breaking change (clients would need to be modified or server configuration would need to be modified in order to avoid client changes). I was thinking this would be part of a 4.8.0 release.
OK, we can wait on changing the default.
As for the documentation mentioned in this ticket, your plan is to expand this page?
Should we go ahead with making the default a queue for 5.0.0?
: I would have concerns that unsuspecting installations would run into memory issues with unread messages building up.
I think we should make the documentation for configuring a Queue prominent, as well as disabling messaging:
Maybe we can discuss on the tech call.
Virtual topics too.  They have been so convenient for us
The default amq configuration in the war, at least for 4.7, is completely broken for supporting all but the smallest queues.  Need to check to see if it has changed or not.  If not, it's an easy fix
The current config in activemq.xml has resource limits of 20MB for memory, 1GB disk space, and 100MB temp disk space. Do you think those need to be changed?
Added usage comments to the fcrepo-config.xml file.
The default JMS broker configuration uses an activemq topic. There should be documentation for how to set up the use of a queue.
Make clear that we should not use topics in production.
which has been filled out for 4.7

As for the documentation mentioned in this ticket, your plan is to expand this page?
